You will be responsible for the mechanical design, development, analysis and review of Display packaging, A-surface development along with B-side integration (clips, screw bosses, etc.) for our next generation SDV (Software Defined Vehicle) architecture. You will be depended upon to build strong partnerships with internal and external customers.<br /> </p><p>What You’ll do:</p><ul><li>Execute mechanical design of displays per program timing, leading to<br />successful launch of the product.</li><li>Using GM Studio theme (i.e., A-surface) as the guide, design mechanical components including castings, injection moldings, stampings, seals, PCBA mounts, adhesives, connector interface and fastening, etc.</li><li>Perform design calculations, GD&amp;T and tolerance stacks.</li><li>Perform optimum material selection for specific applications within the display and for their interface to the vehicle (IP &amp; Console, for example), using GM best practices and Materials Engineering as a partner in this selection.</li><li>Create 3D CAD, 2D CAD &amp; lead CAD reviews with stakeholders.</li><li>Develop analysis and test plan for new design, perform proof of concept tests and analysis.</li><li>Lead prototyping and testing, analyze test data, and make necessary<br />adjustments to mechanical designs.</li><li>Work   with   electrical   engineers   and   PCBA   designers   to   integrate components into electro-mechanical systems.</li><li>Support root cause analysis and solution development based on virtual and/or physical test results.</li><li>Build partnerships with functional peers internally within GM and<br />externally at Tier 1 suppliers to align on display design per development cycles.</li><li>Develop virtualization technologies that help accelerate and de-risk<br />product development.</li><li>Communicate design progress and risks to stakeholders and customers.</li><li>Drive mechanical design strategy for the enterprise.</li><li>Solid organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects<br />simultaneously.<br /> </li></ul><p>Your Skills &amp; Abilities (Required Qualifications)</p><ul><li>BS in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent engineering degree</li><li>10&#43; years of engineering experience in design and development of styled electronics and/or appearance grade injection molding, plating and casting.</li><li>Exceptional collaboration and teamwork skills; demonstrated ability for working across functional and organizational boundaries.</li><li>Proficiency in 3D CAD modeling (NX and Teamcenter are the tools required to execute GM projects), 2D drawings, tolerance analysis, design for manufacturability, and assembly.</li><li>Strong analytical skills and engineering fundamentals in solid mechanics, material science, heat transfer, mechanism design, and manufacturing.</li><li>Hands-on experience engaging with display manufacturers.<br /> </li></ul><p>What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Skills)</p><ul><li>Master’s degree/PhD in Mechanical / Industrial Engineering</li><li>Mechanical design of plastics and structural components, PCBA integration with mechanical components, computers, or automotive electronics</li><li>Strong understanding of thermal solutions and their application.</li><li>Knowledge of vibrational and structural analysis</li><li>Experience with ASME Y14.5-2009 dimensioning &amp;
